role: Buffers streamed LLM text deltas and emits whole sentences (markdown stripped) for AVSpeechSynthesizer; finalize() flushes the tail.
types: SpokenTextChunker: final class — sentence-boundary buffer for TTS
state: mem:SpokenTextChunker.pendingBuffer (private(set) var, per instance; instance held at VoiceConversationController.textChunker)
toplevel: Static sentenceEnders set and the ordered markdownPatterns regex list (intra-word * and _, *word* emphasis, list markers, numbered markers, ATX headers, [label](url)->label).

flags.text: Header says the chunker 'mirrors the prior in-class behavior exactly', but the decimal/link/URL-aware boundary rules (lines 69-98) are later additions that change where chunks are cut.

units.does: Appends delta to pendingBuffer and returns drainCompletedSentence() (a speakable chunk up to the last sentence boundary, or nil).
Trims the buffer, empties it, and returns the markdown-stripped remainder, or nil when the remainder or the stripped text is empty.
Finds the last index where isSentenceBoundary is true, cuts the buffer after it, keeps the rest buffered, and returns the trimmed+markdown-stripped head or nil if it is empty.

flags.text: Scans every buffer index and calls isInsideLinkOrURL (which splits the whole prefix) for each '.', so each append is O(n^2) in buffered length; long unpunctuated streams get slower per delta.

units.does: Decides whether the character at index ends a sentence: '!', '?', '\n' always; '.' only when not inside a link/URL, not followed by a digit/letter, and (if last char) not preceded by a digit.

branches.effect: false ('!', '?', newline): boundary — no link/URL check

branches.cond: '.' is inside a markdown link or URL

branches.effect: true: boundary only if next is neither number nor letter
true: boundary; false: boundary only if previous char is not a number (trailing '42.' waits)

flags.text: '?' and '!' skip the link/URL check, so a URL with a query string ('https://x.com/a?b=1') or a markdown link label with '?' is cut mid-link; the half link is then not matched by the [label](url) strip pattern and its brackets/address are read aloud — the exact failure the '.' rule was added to prevent.

units.does: True when the text before index ends in a token containing '://' or starting 'www.', or is inside an unclosed '[label' or '[label](url' markdown link.

branches.cond: buffer before index has a whitespace-delimited last token
token contains :// or starts with www.

units.does: Removes '**', '__', backticks, then applies markdownPatterns in order (intra-word * and _ removed, *word* emphasis unwrapped, list/number/header markers removed, [label](url)->label).

branches.effect: each regex rewrite applied in order

flags.text: Pattern `(?<=\w)\*(?=\w)` deletes an unspaced multiplication sign, so '5*3' is spoken 'fifty-three'; the comment only protects the spaced form.
